files.description: THE live URL-construction module. app.mjs imports buildAtlasV9DeepLink from exactly this file. ACTIVE_TARGET='ported' (gridatlas/atlas).
the import of the emitter, the four-member TECHNOLOGIES/LABELS/COLOURS/UNITS bucket vocabulary, how project.technology is produced (dictionary lookup), and the MAP button's call site.

the SECOND emitter (wider-fleet tabs for ~20 non-spine REPD technology types). atlasLink() build's its own URLSearchParams independently of atlas-pointer-deep-link.mjs, hitting the same ported base_url.
where row.t ('technology' query param for the wider-fleet emitter) is set to props.get('tech') or 'other' -- the source of the 'other' bucket.

the composer/loader at the live route /gridatlas/atlas/. Fetches current.json, fetches the pinned immutable shell, verifies+splices the 4 cartridges by SHA-256, document.writes the result. Does not itself touch the query string.

the composition manifest: cartridge_order, per-cartridge generation/version/path/sha256, and the full narrative changelog (version_ledger entries v9.16-v9.111) documenting every deep-link fix including the v9.109 bucket-table fix.

FIRST parse site: repd_ref identity + advisory-field parse (suppliedArrivalFields), exact-register lookup, state.deep_link publication. Assembled into the live 'uk-gazetteer-flyto' cartridge; fires on DOMContentLoaded, ahead of the engine and sld-sandbox scripts.

REPD_IDS (the engine's real layer-id vocabulary: has 'wind', not 'wind_onshore'/'wind_offshore'/'other') and focusCanonicalProjectDeepLink(), the engine's OWN former deep-link handler, now reduced to a no-op that publishes DEFERRED_TO_EXACT_REPD_RECEIVER and returns. Carried into the live 'substation-intelligence' cartridge, third script loaded.

THE FIX: PROJECT_TECHS (arrival-acceptance set, includes wind_onshore/wind_offshore/other so the arrival is never abandoned), LAYER_ID_FOR_BUCKET (the one canonical mapping table: wind_onshore->'wind', wind_offshore->'wind', other->null), layerIdForBucket(). This is the v9.109 fix cartridge-side.
deepLinkPlan(): pure route decision (MEASURE_LINK_FIRST / WAIT_FOR_REGISTER / NO_USABLE_POINT) from raw longitude/latitude/repd_ref.

waitForLayerControls(12000) -- the 12s grid-data budget and 'The grid data has not finished loading yet' banner; enableTechnologyLayer() -- the 'layer control not found: <id>' failure; watchForLayerControls() -- late-arrival recovery via MutationObserver.

runDeepLink(): the full arrival sequence -- parses zoom (previously unread by the whole repo), branches MEASURE_LINK_FIRST vs WAIT_FOR_REGISTER, flies the camera, runs arrive() (layer wait+enable), runs runArrivalSelection() (card-before-lines), reconciles against a later-resolved register identity.
the visibility-gated call site of runDeepLink() (void runDeepLink()), with up-to-5-attempt retry on visibilitychange -- guards against the iOS Safari background-tab requestAnimationFrame stall.
